title: Patch: the AI counts a Unit standing in the backrow once, as a Unit, and not again as a backrow card
thread:
**Issue #2490 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #2490: Patch: the AI counts a Unit standing in the backrow once, as a Unit, and not again as a backrow card
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
Some units can fly into the backrow, the row where traps and field spells normally sit, and a Starship waits there before it launches. When the practice AI scores a board, it counts such a unit twice: once as the unit it is, and again as if it were a trap or a field spell in that zone. So a Stratos in the backrow is worth more to the AI than the same Stratos in front, though the rules make it the same unit wherever it stands. That pulls the AI toward parking its flyers in zones its traps and field spells need, and toward overrating the opponent's flyers there as targets. Once built, a unit in the backrow scores exactly what it scores in the unit row.

## Why
- R1081000 (§3.2, §6.1 Flying): "A Flying Unit standing in the backrow is a Unit for every rule". R2249000 summons a Dormant Starship into the backrow, "standing there as a Flying Unit played into the backrow stands".
- `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `material`, prices that card twice:
  - 581-587 price every unit from `units_on_field_of`, a walk that includes `standing_units_of` (`crates/engine/src/zones.rs:1706-1716`, which reads the backrow).
  - 622-655 then walk the same `side.backrow` and add `backrow_base + backrow_per_cost × cost` to every card the seat can read. Nothing skips a Unit standing there, and a Unit is public to both seats, so both sides' scores are inflated.
- `AI_EVAL` has those weights at 1.5 and 0.8 (`crates/ai/src/config.rs:565-566`): an extra 2.3 points for a 1-mana Stratos (S #68) and 4.7 for a 4-mana Galaxy (S #80), for nothing on the board.
- The search's root tries every placement of a play (`root_candidate_set`, `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs:762-766`), and the search's signature keeps a backrow line apart from a unit-row line (`simulate.rs`, the backrow part), so the extra points decide where a flyer lands.
- `crates/ai/src` never calls `is_standing_unit`, `standing_units_of` or `stands_in_backrow`, though Units have stood in the backrow since #1089.
- R2380000's "What does not change" records that a Dormant Starship there "keeps the backrow's price by its printed cost too, as every Unit standing there does", but gives no reason a Unit should earn a backrow card's price on top of its own.
- Reach: 12 Units print Flying (all Stinkyscape, 4 of them tokens), Space Doctrine (S #137.4) gives every one of a player's Units Flying for the rest of the game, and every Starship deck's Dormant Starship stands in the backrow.

## Proposal
In `material`'s backrow walk, skip a card the unit walk above it already priced: a Unit standing in that zone (`is_standing_unit`, which the engine exports). Put it behind a new `EvalWeights` switch, on in `AI_EVAL` and off in `GREEDY_EVAL`, as `defense_own_taunt_kept` is (`config.rs:318`, `476`, `678`), so the frozen baseline the quality gates measure against does not move (`config.rs:668-671`). A new ruling in the issue's block says a Unit standing in the backrow is priced once, as a Unit; R2380000's sentence about the Dormant Starship is edited to link it.

## Where it lands
- `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` (`material`), `crates/ai/src/config.rs` (`EvalWeights`, `AI_EVAL`, `GREEDY_EVAL`)
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/ranged_flying.rs` or `crates/ai/tests/ai/evaluate.rs`
- `spec/rulings/R<n>.md`, `spec/rulings/R2380000.md`, `spec/pending/<issue>.md`; SPEC §9 (the practice AI), R1081000, R2249000

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] On two copies of one board, Stratos (stinkyscape-068) in unit lane 1 on one and standing in backrow lane 1 on the other, `evaluate` under `AI_EVAL` gives the same score, with Stratos on the AI's side and again with it on the enemy's.
- [ ] A Dormant Starship standing in the backrow is priced by its slumber price alone under `AI_EVAL`, with no backrow price on top.
- [ ] A face-down Trap, a face-up Field Spell and a set card's grade counter in the backrow are priced as before.
- [ ] Under `GREEDY_EVAL` every score is what it was.
- [ ] The tests are named after the new ruling, which lists their file in `proven_in`; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` and the smoke gate (`cargo jackioh gate`) pass.

## Size and risks
Small in code, about 6 files and under 100 lines with the tests, but hard by CLAUDE.md rule 11, since it changes how the AI plays. Every board with a flyer or a Starship plays differently, so `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` may ask for a pending fragment, and the change deserves the usual self-play check against the current AI. One case needs a decision in the ruling: an Animated backrow card that is standing as a Unit at the moment (R2280001; Rod of Ages, S #16, is an Animated Field Spell with Flying) is priced by the unit walk, by the backrow walk and by `animated_share`; the ruling should say which single price it takes, and a test should pin it.

## Goal

`material()` in the AI evaluation prices a Unit standing in the backrow twice: once as a Unit in the unit walk, again as a backrow card in the backrow walk. | `spec/rulings/R2380000.md` | change | "What does not change" Starship sentence rewritten to link `R2490000`; append `R2490000` to `cards` |
| `spec/pending/2490.md` | new | the §11 paragraph for `R2490000` |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | §9.9 Evaluation bullet: one sentence after the `R2380000` sentence |

Re-read the spec and code: §9.9 Evaluation bullet in `spec/09-architecture.md`, `spec/rulings/R1081000.md`, `R2249000.md`, `R2280000.md`, `R2380000.md`, and `material()` in `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` (lines 578–656). Note the unit walk at 582–587 already prices standing Units via `units_on_field_of`, and the backrow walk at 622–655 has no standing-unit skip.
2. In `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, add the switch to `EvalWeights` after `backrow_per_cost` (line 426), copying the `defense_own_taunt_kept` pattern (lines 315–318, 476, 677–678):
   - Field with doc: `/// R2490000: a Unit standing in the backrow is priced once, as the Unit the unit walk priced — the backrow walk skips it. Off, it keeps the old backrow price on top, as the frozen baseline did.` named `pub standing_unit_priced_once: bool`.

   - `GREEDY_EVAL`: `standing_unit_priced_once: false` with comment `// The baseline is frozen: it priced a standing Unit again as a backrow card, as it did.`
   - Search the repo for other `EvalWeights {` literals; only `AI_EVAL` and `GREEDY_EVAL` construct it (tests use `..AI_EVAL`), so nothing else needs the field.
3. In `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, add `is_standing_unit` to the `jackioh_engine::{...}` import (alphabetical: after `hero_armor_of`, before `is_temporary_card`), and insert at the top of the backrow loop body (before the `lapsing` check at line 623):

   // R2490000: a Unit standing in the backrow is priced once, as the Unit the unit walk above
   // priced, never again as a backrow card (R1081000: it is a Unit for every rule, and a count
   // of permanents counts it once).
   if w.standing_unit_priced_once && is_standing_unit(state, card) {
       continue;

   ```
   The skip covers the whole body (backrow price, `animated_share` top-up, grade counter): no carve-outs. Append to `material()`'s doc comment (line 576): ", never a Unit standing there (R2490000)" after the backrow clause.
4. Write `spec/rulings/R2490000.md` with front matter `id: R2490000`, title `The AI prices a Unit standing in the backrow once, as a Unit (issue #2490)`, `cards: "§3.2, §6.1 Flying, §9.9, R1081000, R2249000, R2280000, R2380000; S #16, S #68, S #80, T-dormant-starship"`, `proven_in: [crates/ai/tests/ai/evaluate.rs]`. Rejected: keeping the backrow price or the top-up on top of the unit price.
5. In `spec/rulings/R2380000.md`, replace the sentence "A Dormant Starship standing in the backrow ([[R2249000]]) keeps the backrow's price by its printed cost too, as every Unit standing there does ([[R1081000]])." with "A Dormant Starship standing in the backrow ([[R2249000]]) counts its slumber price alone, never a backrow price on top, as every Unit standing there counts its own price once ([[R2490000]])." Append `R2490000` to its `cards`.
6. Write `spec/pending/2490.md` with one paragraph: `**[[R2490000]] prices a Unit standing in the backrow once, as a Unit (issue #2490, 2026-10-30)**: ... takes R2490000, the first number of issue #2490's block, amends [[R2380000]] and edits [[§9.9]].`
7. In `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.9 Evaluation bullet, insert after "...until it wakes ([[R2380000]]).": " A Unit standing in the backrow ([[§3.2]], [[R1081000]]) counts once, as the Unit it is, never again as a backrow card ([[R2490000]])."
8. In `crates/ai/tests/ai/evaluate.rs`, add `mod r2490000_backrow_unit_priced_once` reusing the file's `board()`, `scored`-style helper (`evaluate(state, AI, NextSwing::Enemy, w)`), `assert_close(..., 9)`, and `clone`. Setup facts the tests rely on (all verified): the scenario harness refuses a Unit with explicit backrow row, so standing flyers are built by playing them (`s.play("stinkyscape-068", json!({"zone": 1, "row": "backrow"}))`; unit row via `json!({"zone": 1})`); Stratos (`stinkyscape-068`, (1) 3/3 Flying, no Cry) plays cleanly; keep a Vanilla in hand so the turn never auto-ends (both boards identical except the row); `testkit::*` re-exports `place_standing_on_field`, `ZoneSlot`, `PlaceOnFieldOptions`, `is_standing_unit`, `animated_with_stats`, `Slumber`, `Row`.
   - Helpers: `own_stratos(backrow: bool)`, `enemy_stratos(backrow: bool)` (p1 hand `[STRATOS, VANILLA]` vs p2 hand `[STRATOS, VANILLA]`, play that side's Stratos; assert `is_standing_unit` for the backrow board); `starship_in_backrow()` (setup `field: [{ "def": "stinkyscape-t-dormant-starship", "slumber": {}, "statsOverride": {"attack": 2, "health": 3} }]` — the override stands in for fused stats since a bare 0/0 would not survive setup's state check — then move lane-1 pile top with `place_standing_on_field` to backrow lane 1; assert standing and waiting slumber).
   - `r2490000_a_backrow_stratos_scores_what_a_unit_row_stratos_scores`: `assert_eq!` of AI-seat scores front vs back, Stratos on AI side and on enemy side (and the same pair from the human seat).
   - `r2490000_a_dormant_starship_in_the_backrow_counts_its_slumber_price_alone`: score difference vs the emptied board `assert_close`s to `AI_EVAL.slumber_waiting_share * unit_worth(awake copy)` (the `slumber.rs` `asleep`/`emptied` pattern).
   - `r2490000_traps_field_spells_and_grade_counters_keep_their_backrow_price`: board with enemy face-down `core-041`, own face-up `core-006`, own `core-093` with `counters: {"grade": 3}`; scores under `AI_EVAL` and an off-switch copy are `assert_eq!`; removing each backrow card moves the score its term's way (proves each term is live).
   - `r2490000_greedy_eval_and_a_closed_switch_keep_the_backrow_price`: `assert!(!GREEDY_EVAL.standing_unit_priced_once)`; front/back Stratos boards differ under `GREEDY_EVAL` and under the off-switch copy by exactly `backrow_base + backrow_per_cost × 1` (2.3), `assert_close` 9 digits.
   - `r2490000_an_animated_standing_unit_counts_its_unit_price_alone`: grant `Keyword::Animated` to the standing Stratos (the `ranged_flying.rs` `grant` pattern); assert `animated_with_stats` is `Some` (proves the triple-count premise); score difference vs the emptied board `assert_close`s to `unit_worth` exactly — no backrow price, no `animated_share` top-up.
9. Run: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai r2490000`, then `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`. Run `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: an AI-eval change needs no patches fragment; if it demands one, stop and report rather than inventing card claims. Do not run the gate, fuzz, workspace suites, or web suites (CI's job).

## Tests

Each test lives in `crates/ai/tests/ai/evaluate.rs`, `mod r2490000_backrow_unit_priced_once`, named above; each fails without the fix (front/back equality breaks by 2.3 points; Starship/animated diffs gain the backrow price; the greedy test fails on the `GREEDY_EVAL` flag). Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai r2490000` for the new tests, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` for the crate, plus clippy, `cargo fmt --check`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` for the ruling note, its `proven_in`, and the `R2490000` code cite.

## Done when

- [ ] Stratos in unit lane 1 vs backrow lane 1 scores equally from both seats, AI-owned and enemy-owned
- [ ] Dormant Starship in backrow scores its slumber price alone; Trap, Field Spell, grade counter prices unchanged
- [ ] `GREEDY_EVAL` scores are what they were (flag off, differential pinned)
- [ ] New ruling lists the test file in `proven_in`, tests are named `r2490000_*`, `cargo jackioh spec check` passes
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, clippy with `-D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` pass; `classify --claims` needs no fragment (or the demand is reported)

## Risks

- Eval determinism: the skip only removes a term; remaining summation order is unchanged, so front/back equality is exact. No replay, signature, or search change.
- Hidden information: `is_standing_unit` reads position and type, both public on both seats (standing Units are public per `R1081000`); face-down/set cards read as Traps and never match, so the enemy-face-down term is untouched.
- The Starship's `statsOverride` is test-only scaffolding for fused stats; pricing reads the same path as a real fused ship.

## Open questions

None. Settled in-plan: switch named `standing_unit_priced_once`; tests in `evaluate.rs` (not `ranged_flying.rs`, which covers combat reads, not board pricing); Animated-standing takes the single unit price (rejected: keeping the `animated_share` top-up).
````
